blocks.text: Significant figures uncertainty ke sirf ek source (zariye) ko dikhate hain: scale parhne ki uncertainty. Asal experiment mein uncertainty kai wajah se aati hai, jaise personal error (napne wale ki apni ghalti) aur kabhi chhupi hui systematic errors (har baar ek hi taraf ki ghalti). Scale jitni ijazat de us se behtar reading nahi li ja sakti, magar total uncertainty significant figures ke andaze se kahin zyada bhi ho sakti hai.

items: Significant figures = pakke maloom digits + pehla estimated digit; yeh instrument ki precision dikhate hain (3.145 g vs 3.1 g).
Zero ke rules: darmiyan wala significant; shuru wale nahi; decimal ke aakhir wale significant; integer mein least count se tay (8.000 × 10³ kg).
Multiply/divide: sab se kam significant figures (1.46 × 10³). Add/subtract: sab se kam decimal places (75.5 m, 8.13 m). Rounding: 5 se kam → waisa hi; 5 se zyada → 1 barhao; bilkul 5 → even ki taraf.
